fitReason: Strong methods overlap for CS/AI research through visual representations, replay-buffer augmentation and sample-efficient learning directly on physical arms. physicalEvidence.summary: SymmGrid (July 2026) trains and evaluates on real Franka manipulation tasks: peg insertion, cable routing and object relocation. It uses ResNet-10 image features plus proprioception, demonstration-seeded RLPD, and parallel translation-based replay augmentation, with special homography handling for external cameras. Current Lipscomb news corroborates local Franka ownership. Broader fractal variants from the precursor are not all hardware-tested.
